# Website Maintenance Services **Keep your website secure, updated and running at peak performance with our reliable maintenance and support services.** *We Maintain. You Focus On Your Business.* --- ### Best For * **Business Websites** * **E-commerce Stores** * **Blog & News Websites** * **Portfolio Websites** * **Educational Websites** * **Non-Profit Organizations** * **Membership & Community Sites** * **Any Active Website** --- ### What You'll Get * **Regular Updates:** We keep your CMS, themes, plugins and extensions updated. * **Performance Optimization:** Speed optimization for faster loading and better UX. * **Security Monitoring:** 24/7 website security monitoring and threat detection. * **Bug Fixes & Support:** Fixing issues, errors and broken functionality quickly. * **Daily Backups:** Automatic daily backups to keep your data safe and recoverable. * **Content Updates:** Update text, images and content as per your requirements. * **Uptime Monitoring:** We monitor your website uptime 24/7 and ensure availability. * **Monthly Reports:** Detailed reports on website health, security and uptime. --- ### Key Benefits * **Enhanced Security:** Protect your website from hacks, malware and vulnerabilities. * **Smooth Performance:** Ensure fast loading and a seamless experience for your visitors. * **Peace of Mind:** We handle the technical part while you focus on your business. * **Cost Effective:** Prevent major issues and costly downtime in the future. * **Better SEO & Rankings:** A well-maintained website performs better on search engines. * **Long-Term Reliability:** Keep your website stable, updated and future-ready always. --- ### Our Maintenance Process | 01 | 02 | 03 | 04 | 05 | 06 | 07 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Website Check**
We perform a thorough health check of your website. | **Updates**
We update core files, themes, plugins and extensions. | **Backup**
We take a full backup of your website and database. | **Security Scan**
We scan for malware, threats and vulnerability issues. | **Optimization**
We optimize speed, images, code and database. | **Testing**
We test all functionalities across devices and browsers. | **Report & Support**
We share a detailed report and provide ongoing support as needed. | --- ### What We Maintain * **CMS & Core Files:** WordPress, PHP, plugins and themes * **Content & Media:** Text, images and media updates * **Security & Malware:** Scanning, firewall and vulnerability checks * **Broken Links & Errors:** Fixing 404 errors and broken links * **Database:** Optimization and regular cleaning * **Forms & Functionalities:** Testing and fixing form submissions * **Performance:** Speed, caching and image optimization * **Cross-Browser & Device:** Compatibility checks --- **Delivery Time:** Ongoing Monthly Service **STARTING FROM ₹2,999 / Month (Basic Plan)** * Daily Backups Included * Regular Updates * Security Monitoring * Uptime Monitoring * Performance Optimization * Content Updates (Basic) * Email Support * Monthly Reports --- ### Add-On Services (One Time / As Needed) | Service | Starting Price | | :--- | :--- | | **Malware Removal** | ₹1,999 | | **Website Speed Optimization** | ₹2,999 | | **On-Page SEO Setup** | ₹2,499 | | **Website Content Update** | ₹999 | | **Website Redesign** | ₹9,999 | --- *We Care For Your Website, So You Can Care For Your Business. | www.yourwebsite.com*
